historical_record.description: A service station opened on the former brewery lot in 1932 on a ten-year lease worth $15,600, with an option running to 1946.
The service station, closed for about a decade, was demolished in 1980.
Condominiums replaced the station and its concrete lot in 1982.

unknowns: The neighborhood newsletter dates the condominiums to 1982; the assessor's roll gives 1981.
